svg.aria-label: How ZettelFlow works, in one continuous shot: a Canvas flow is walked step by step — Capture, Classify, then the Concept branch, then Connect — while the wizard it drives asks for the idea, its kind, its tags and the links your graph suggests, and the live preview fills in. Create, and the new note flies into your graph, lands between two regions and draws its links, becoming a bridge.
svg.title: How it works: the Canvas, the wizard, your graph
